entries.description: Chapwa chakutamo kuhasa kukanyisa jijila jize jakuyanjisilamo Mutu
entries.subject: Chapwa chakutamo

spans.text: Chapwa chakutamo kuhasa kukanyisa jijila jize jakuyanjisilamo Mutu, kaha makuwana nawa jijila jeka Mutu nahase kuyoyelamo muno mu Kaye mwahasa kupwa na Lusesa lwakuhasa kulihanjikila, kupwa nachinyingi chakutanga mazu akalunga mwazanga chakuhona kupwa nawoma.
Chapwa chakutamo Mutu kuhona kumushinjila kulinga vyuma vyavipi navihasa kumuwanyisa kukaluhwa mu chiyoyelo chenyi kupwa nge jila yakukumishilako, Lushimbi lwakufwana ngana lwatela kupwako.

entries.task_id: ja lusesa|kana|ja mutu kwesekesa nalushiko lwa chivwashano echi
entries.description: ja Lusesa kana ja Mutu kwesekesa nalushiko lwa chivwashano echi
entries.subject: ja Lusesa
entries.object: ja Mutu kwesekesa nalushiko lwa chivwashano echi

spans.text: Chapwa nawa chakutamo nakumona nge kuli chivwashano cha jishimbi ja Lusesa kana ja Mutu kwesekesa nalushiko lwa chivwashano echi.
Lusesa kana kalwechi kupwa nge mujila yize nayijila kwesekesa najijila jajipi javihande vyamafuchi chipwe kavetavila kwesekesa navishinganyeka vyakava United Nations.

Mutu wosena analusesa lwakulitambukila nakushinganyeka, mukutwama chenyi namumazu akalunga, lusesa kana elu lwakwitavisa wuze mutu kufuma kala muchikungulwilo chamazu akalunga eka nakwingila kweka, chipwe numba wukawenyi numba navakwavo muze mungalila, kuhasa kutwalaho namazu kana nakutangisa namuvilombelo vyenyi.

entries.object: echi cha Lusesa lwajingolo ja Mutu chatela kuchitachikiza nakuchikavangiza kuvatu vosena vamu vamuchivulu muchiyoyelo chavo

spans.text: Chivwashano kana echi cha Lusesa lwajingolo ja Mutu chatela kuchitachikiza nakuchikavangiza kuvatu vosena vamu vamuchivulu muchiyoyelo chavo, nakulama nawa lushiko lwa chivwashano kana mukachi ka Vatu vosena hamwe na Mafuchi atwama mu Chikungulwilo kana chazango eyi ya Chivwashano.

entries.description: vanawane mutu kana anamulonga wunapandama kuchiyoyelo chenyi
entries.subject: vanawane mutu

spans.text: Mutu wosena analusesa lwakwivwilila chihande chenyi ku zango yayinene yakaye yakulimanyina, nge vanawane mutu kana anamulonga wunapandama kuchiyoyelo chenyi.
Kakwechi kukapwa kuwanyina mulonga mutuko mwomwo hakuhona kumuwanyina chihande chamulonga wawunene, kwesekesa najishimbi jamuze mulifuchi chipwe kaye, halwola kana alvulumwine wuze mulonga.
Chipwe kakwechi kukahana mulonga wawunene wuze mutuko kuhambakana wuze mulonga avulumine halwola kana lwakavanga.
